svg.title: Kaplan Level 2: proposed zones and workstation locations
svg.desc: Four owner-proposed zones on the existing floor plan. Fifty MDes workstations follow printed labels. Fourteen PhD workstations have proposed, unverified positions along the right side. Faculty and PhD boundaries overlap at the lower right.

g.text: Draft · September 7, 2026 · proposed zones over the 2018 reference drawing

g.text: 50 MDes records at printed labels · 14 PhD records in proposed positions
Dashed PhD desk markers are schematic. Confirm placement, numbering and circulation on site.
Existing furniture underneath is an older reference. Faculty assignments have not been inferred.
Every workstation appears once. This draft has not been saved to Airtable.
